newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver end firmer.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver end firmer.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed 15 rupees higher at 4,765 rupees per 10 gramme as fresh wedding season demand emerged and prices rose on world markets prompting speculative local buying.
** Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed 200 rupees higher at 55,700 rupees per piece. They fell 600 rupees last week.
** Silver (.999) closed 85 rupees higher at 6,880 rupees per kg as speculative interest responded to a recovery in world prices, but industrial buying remained slow.
